notes: Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF/block), consistent with prior Home-Decor pass's access notes. Found the site's dedicated 'Pet' department (breadcrumb facetValueName 'ペット用品' = 'Pet Supplies') via https://www.nitori-net.jp/ecstatic/sitemap/sitemap_item_1.xml, which lists exactly 14 /ec/cat/Pet/... URLs: the parent /Pet/1/ plus 13 flat (single-level) leaf categories -- no deeper Pet sub-sub-categories exist in the sitemap. Each leaf fetched directly; qty taken from the embedded <script id="nitoristore-state"> SSR JSON blob at cx-state.product.search.results.pagination.totalResults (same first-party SAP Commerce/Spartacus search-API total used and validated in the prior Home-Decor/Furniture pass for this company). Rule-1 exhaustion check performed on the largest category (PetBed, 109 items): page 1 returned 60 products, page 2 returned 49 distinct additional products (0 title overlap), 60+49=109 exact -- confirms totalResults is not inflated. All 13 leaf categories were read via their SSR product-title lists (221 product titles inspected total) to check for pet food/treats or medical/veterinary items per the brief's two open flag policies: none found -- 'フード' hits were all feeder/scale/bowl hardware (e.g. ペットフード用スケール = pet food scale, ウェットフード対応自動給餌器 = wet-food-compatible auto feeder), not food products themselves; no medicine/vaccine/treatment terms found anywhere. No flags needed. PetFurniture (33 items) contains a small minority of pet-memorial items (ペット用骨壺 = pet urn, ペット仏壇 = pet altar, メモリアルハウス/メモリアルフォトスタンド = memorial house/photo stand) mixed in with genuine pet furniture (pet sofas, cat towers, pet beds, pet fences, pet tables) -- kept the category intact since memorial items are a small minority (~3/33) of a category the site itself defines as a single pet-specific branch ('ペット家具'), not a mixed roll-up requiring curation. Parent /Pet/1/ totalResults=534 is less than the sum of the 13 leaf totals (578) -- expected for a faceted category tree with cross-listed products (e.g. auto-feeders appear in both PetAppliances and PetTableware); parent recorded as a grouping row with qty null per the brief's grouping rule, not as a discrepancy. No PLPs found outside the /Pet/ branch (checked full 825-URL category list for Dog/Cat/Animal-named paths outside /Pet/ -- none). All 13 leaf categories are Tier-1 decisive Pet Care signals per the brief boundary rules (feeding/tableware, beds/bedding, grooming/nail-care, hygiene/toilet, toys, cat furniture/scratchers, walking/wear, travel/carriers, housing/cages/gates) -- no exclusions applied.
